summary: The sysvinit module controls services on SysV init systems; at least one option besides name is required.
questions: How do I manage SysV init services with Ansible?
What's required for the sysvinit module?

answer_card.title: Manage SysV services
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.sysvinit` manages SysV init services. Requires `name` plus at least one other option (`state` or `enabled`).
